verdict.rationale: Intel documents an NPU with a published TOPS figure (up to 48 TOPS for Core Ultra Series 2) and ships official runtimes/SDKs (OpenVINO toolkit, oneAPI/oneDNN with PyTorch optimizations) that developers can use today to target the NPU/GPU/CPU AI engines. missing for 10: an explicit precision spec (e.g., INT8/FP16) tied to the 48 TOPS figure, and independent hands-on developer corroboration beyond Intel's own docs.
